subject.title: [Feature Request] Add streamTo="parent" support for runtime="subagent"

question: Should native `runtime="subagent"` support `streamTo="parent"`, and if so what child progress, tool data, redaction, and routing contract is allowed to cross into the parent session or channel?
rationale: Current code can safely ignore the ACP-only field, but implementing live native progress changes what isolated child-session data becomes visible to parent users and channels, which is a product and security boundary choice.

options.title: Design redacted native progress relay
options.body: Add native parent progress only for bounded lifecycle/progress summaries first, with requester routing, cleanup, and redaction tests before any tool-result or thinking visibility.

options.title: Keep ACP-only streamTo
options.body: Document `streamTo` as permanently ACP-only and leave native subagents on completion events plus `/subagents` inspection.

options.title: Expose structured child event stream
options.body: Build a broader child-event subscription surface for native subagents, but require a larger design covering tool output, thinking visibility, and channel delivery limits.

recommendation.title: Design redacted native progress relay
recommendation.body: Add native parent progress only for bounded lifecycle/progress summaries first, with requester routing, cleanup, and redaction tests before any tool-result or thinking visibility.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses current agent/session ownership and security tradeoffs, and Peter is the strongest recent current-main history signal on the relevant files.
